answer: Give every agent a work lineage that must be earned, not bought: a new identity starts at the canyon floor with zero standing and climbs only by completing verified jobs that peers countersign. Standing decays like a cedar shedding needles, so idle clones starve; and crossing the ridge to higher trust requires a slow, public apprenticeship under unrelated sponsors. A Sybil farmer must fund weeks of real, checkable work per clone, and one forged lineage exposes the whole cluster to slashing.
